say:1:1322148001:1.text: Hey, mister! Let me tell you a secret. When I was in the Ghostly Getaway, I saw a Graveborn!
say:1:1322148001:1.male: Hey, mister! Let me tell you a secret. When I was in the Ghostly Getaway, I saw a Graveborn!
say:1:1322148001:1.female: Hey, lady! Let me tell you a secret. When I was in the Ghostly Getaway, I saw a Graveborn!

say:3:1322148003:1.text: I don't know his name, but he was funny—always hopping around on the gravestones and wanting to play with me.
say:3:1322148003:1.source_cn: 我不知道他叫什么，但他很有趣，总是在墓碑上跳来跳去的，...

say:4:1322148004:1.text: Igor isn't a bad person, but you were really brave to play with him...
say:4:1322148004:1.source_cn: 虽然知道伊戈尔不是坏人，但你还真胆大啊，居然敢在密室里...

say:5:1322148005:1.text: He's not scary at all! Besides, I'm the bravest kid in Cedartown!
say:5:1322148005:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，当然啦，他一点都不可怕。而且，我是整个雪松镇最勇...
